usage: agentware gate release [-h] [--format {text,json}] [--full]
                              [--tolerance TOLERANCE]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --full                run heavyweight Tier-B gates (own-gold, LongMemEval,
                        SWE-task)
  --tolerance TOLERANCE
                        regression tolerance for retrieval metrics (default:
                        0.02)
